# SEO-065: Reach every indexable page through a crawlable anchor href

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

Each page the site wants indexed is reachable from at least one other indexable page by following anchor elements that carry a resolvable href attribute in the delivered document.

## Rationale

A crawler discovers pages by following hrefs, so a page linked only through a click handler, a form submission, or a script-built route has no discovery path and is found only if some other source happens to reveal its address.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Replace navigation built on click handlers with anchor elements carrying real hrefs, keeping any script behaviour as an enhancement on top. Where a route is only reachable through a form, add an equivalent linked entry point such as an index or archive page.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Walk the anchor graph of the delivered documents from the home page and list route-inventory entries no walk reaches.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`, `RAW_HTML`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
